goto.note: Navigates the page. No locator involved.

left_click.note: Explicit left click. `click` is the normal choice.

fill.note: Optional `storeAs` saves the filled value as a runtime variable. `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

clear.note: Empties an input. Use this rather than `fill` with an empty string - the validator rejects a `fill` step with empty `data`, so this is the only way to express clearing a field.

select_option.note: `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

wait.note: Falls back to `timeout`, then to 1000. Prefer an assertion over a fixed wait where possible.

switch_new_tab.note: Switches the engine to the most recently opened tab.

store_text.note: Reads the element's text into a runtime variable. `variable` is required and throws at runtime if absent.

save_storage_state.note: Defaults to `.auth/user.json`. Used to capture an authenticated session for reuse via `config.storageState`.

verify_visible.note: Do not use on generic wrappers or body containers - assert a concrete outcome instead.

verify_text.note: Exact match. `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

verify_text_contains.note: Partial match. `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

verify_not_contains_text.note: `data` must be non-empty - the validator enforces this.

verify_url_contains.note: No locator involved. The preferred assertion for redirection.

verify_attribute.note: `attribute` is required and throws at runtime if absent.

api_get.note: Optional `headers` and `store_response` ({ key, variable }). Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

api_post.note: Optional `headers` and `store_response` ({ key, variable }). Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

api_delete.note: Optional `headers`. Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

mock_route.note: Optional `mockData` (or `data`), `status` (default 200), `contentType` (default application/json). `status` is the mocked response status and asserts nothing.

unmock_route.note: Removes a route mock installed by `mock_route`.

call_flow.note: Reusable step sequence. Nesting is capped at depth 10. The validator checks the flow file exists.

wait_for_element.note: Optional `state` (`visible` default, or `hidden` / `attached` / `detached`) and `timeout` in ms (default 10000). Prefer this over `wait` - a fixed sleep is both slower than needed and still too short under load.

api_put.note: Optional `headers` and `store_response` ({ key, variable }). Full replacement of a resource. Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.

api_patch.note: Optional `headers` and `store_response` ({ key, variable }). Partial update of a resource. Optional `expected_status` asserts the response status exactly; without it any 2xx or 3xx passes.
